cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Fail-closed allowlisted SQLite ledger binder for African MSME shops: answers are a function of local credit/payable/stock rows; missing fields produce refusal; the deterministic binder message is authoritative and the LLM is constrained to narrate cited rows only.

test_prompts.prompt: LEDGER_JSON is authoritative. Customer Esther Tchamba has credit_limit=null (not on file) and outstanding=500 XAF. Caisse boisson malt 300ml unit_price=720. Staff ask: Can I give Esther Tchamba one crate on credit? Answer using only the ledger data provided; refuse if any required field is missing.
LEDGER_JSON is authoritative. Product Sucre 25kg has on_hand=4 and unit_price=13500 XAF. Staff ask: How many bags of sugar do we have in stock? Answer using only the ledger data provided.
